item.title: Pope escalates call for ceasefire in Iran by addressing those responsible for the war
item.summary: Pope Leo XIV called on leaders in the Iran war to reopen talks.

item.title: As other Iran‑allied groups are engaging in the Mideast war, Yemen's Houthis hold back
item.summary: Yemen’s Iran-backed Houthi rebels are staying on the sidelines as the Iran war expands

item.title: Artillery attack on a Yemen village kills at least 10 as government blames Houthi rebels
item.summary: An artillery strike has hit a village in northern Yemen and killed at least 10 people, including six children

item.title: 2 dead after 2 boats carrying students capsize off US base construction site in southern Japan
item.summary: Two boats carrying 21 people capsized off Henoko, a controversial relocation site for a U.S. military base on the Japanese island of Okinawa, throwing all into the water and killing two, officials said

item.title: Armed group killed security personnel in an ambush in north-central Nigeria, authorities say
item.summary: Gunmen ambushed and killed security personnel in Nigeria’s Plateau state.

item.title: Myanmar’s parliament meets for first time in 5 years with military controlling most seats
item.summary: Myanmar has opened its first parliamentary session in more than five years following an election that did not include major opposition parties, ensuring that the ruling military is set to retain a firm grasp on power

item.title: After quieter weeks, Taiwan reports large-scale Chinese military aircraft presence near the island
item.summary: Taiwan is seeing a surge of Chinese military planes near the island after a sharp drop in flights over the past two weeks had sparked discussions among observers

item.title: Pakistan says it hit militant hideouts in Afghanistan’s Kandahar as fighting shows no letup
item.summary: Pakistan says it struck militant hideouts in Afghanistan as cross-border fighting intensified and both sides traded blame

item.title: Roof collapse at Pakistan welfare payment site kills at least 8 women
item.summary: A crowded welfare payment line in eastern Pakistan has turned deadly after a shop roof collapsed, killing at least eight women

item.title: Kazakhstan's new constitution cementing president's grip on power approved in a referendum
item.summary: A new constitution that strengthens President Kassym-Jomart Tokayev’s grip on power in Kazakhstan, Central Asia’s largest country, has won overwhelming approval in a referendum
